title: World War Z: An Oral History of the Zombie War
author: Max Brooks
summary: Told as a collection of interviews gathered years after a global zombie plague, this novel lets survivors from many countries describe how it began, how governments failed and how humanity fought back.
readIf: you like zombie stories that read like a global history, with variety across places and voices.
skipIf: you want one central hero or a single driving plot, since it's a mosaic of accounts.

pairings.reason: Another large-scale pandemic story that follows many lives, though quieter, with more beauty and hope.
The shorter, lonelier classic of one man facing a world overrun by infected monsters.
Another sweeping story of societal collapse after plague and the rebuilding that follows, with more fantasy.
